_about: Live Gemma 4 run 2026-10-18 07:48:35-08:21:30 UTC, cam-handheld replaying tour-medium.mp4 (896.8 s) in a loop at PERCEPTION_STRIDE_S=30 (5 s windows), 2 full passes + start of pass 3. Raw replies read-only from RustFS via the media proxy; stored locations from the CNPG replica. video_offset_s follows nasa_eval.real.score_run alignment (first window = video t 0, modulo 896.8 s); the phase drifts +3.2 s per pass (30 s stride x 30 windows = 900 s). caption_module = srt_truth.module_timeline truth at video_t_mid. Private windows: no text (as stored). replay_current = LocationResolver.window_policy + ModuleCarry(45 s) + caption_scene_change on the current code (matches stored_location for every capturable window).
